name: An Unfortunate End

aliases: who is the dead night watchman
faq.answer: The fallen body belongs to a member of the Night Watch, the town guard tasked with patrolling the dark roads and borders of Duskwood. He met a violent demise alone in the shadows.
He was mauled by a large beast, leaving his corpse marked by profound gashes and savage cuts. The creature responsible overtook him before he could defend himself or light his way.

aliases: what do i do with the torch
faq.answer: The unlit torch taken from the guard's grip can illuminate the surrounding gloom, helping wanderers expose things veiled by the heavy darkness of Duskwood and lands beyond.

sections.body: A fallen member of the Night Watch lies quiet upon the dark soil of Duskwood, his body marked by severe gashes and cuts from a savage encounter. The ferocious wounds suggest that a massive beast ambushed the patrolman before he had any chance to escape.
sections.title: A Grim Discovery

sections.body: Clutched within the fallen guard's rigid fingers rests an unlit torch. Taking the brand from his grasp provides a valuable tool against the encroaching shadows, capable of exposing things that remain concealed within the deep gloom of Duskwood and other darkened paths.
sections.title: Light in the Darkness

summary: A fallen Night Watchman lies in the gloom of Duskwood, brutally mauled by an unknown predator. Recovering the unlit brand from his cold fingers offers a way to penetrate the surrounding darkness and reveal whatever stays hidden within the shadows.
attribution: In-game quest text: An Unfortunate End
